SELECT bb.typeId,bb.typeName,cc.assigned_date as eventDate FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ala.type_value typeId,ala.type_name typeName FROM sys_alarm_type ala
AND ala.type_value IN
#{labelIdItem}
UNION SELECT 'aaa666' typeId,'其他' typeName ) bb, (SELECT date_format(assigned_date,'%Y-%m-%d') assigned_date FROM (SELECT adddate('2021-01-01',t3.i*1000 + t2.i*100 + t1.i*10 + t0.i) assigned_date FROM (select 0 i union select 1 union select 2 union select 3 union select 4 union select 5 union select 6 union select 7 union select 8 union select 9) t0, (select 0 i union select 1 union select 2 union select 3 union select 4 union select 5 union select 6 union select 7 union select 8 union select 9) t1, (select 0 i union select 1 union select 2 union select 3 union select 4 union select 5 union select 6 union select 7 union select 8 union select 9) t2, (select 0 i union select 1 union select 2 union select 3 union select 4 union select 5 union select 6 union select 7 union select 8 union select 9) t3 ) c WHERE assigned_date between SUBSTR(#{queryStartTime},1,10) and #{queryEndTime}) cc
ORDER BY cc.assigned_date,FIELD(bb.typeId,
#{labelIdItem}
,'aaa666') ASC

SELECT bb.tagId,bb.tagName,cc.assigned_date as eventDate FROM (SELECT tag_id as 'tagId',tag_name as 'tagName' FROM sys_alarm_tags where delete_flag = '0'
AND tag_id IN
#{labelIdItem}
UNION SELECT 'aaa666' tagId, '其他' tagName ) bb, (SELECT date_format(assigned_date,'%Y-%m-%d') assigned_date FROM (SELECT adddate('2021-01-01',t3.i*1000 + t2.i*100 + t1.i*10 + t0.i) assigned_date FROM (select 0 i union select 1 union select 2 union select 3 union select 4 union select 5 union select 6 union select 7 union select 8 union select 9) t0, (select 0 i union select 1 union select 2 union select 3 union select 4 union select 5 union select 6 union select 7 union select 8 union select 9) t1, (select 0 i union select 1 union select 2 union select 3 union select 4 union select 5 union select 6 union select 7 union select 8 union select 9) t2, (select 0 i union select 1 union select 2 union select 3 union select 4 union select 5 union select 6 union select 7 union select 8 union select 9) t3 ) c WHERE assigned_date between SUBSTR(#{queryStartTime},1,10) and #{queryEndTime}) cc
ORDER BY cc.assigned_date,FIELD(bb.tagId,
#{labelIdItem}
,'aaa666') ASC

SELECT IFNULL(SUM(dataTable.today_all),0) AS 'todayAll', IFNULL(SUM(dataTable.today_complete),0) AS todayComplete,IFNULL(SUM(dataTable.false_complete_num),0) AS 'falseCompleteNum', IFNULL(SUM(dataTable.judge_num),0) AS judgeNum,IFNULL(SUM(dataTable.dispatch_num),0) AS 'dispatchNum', IFNULL(SUM(dataTable.grab_num),0) AS grabNum,IFNULL(SUM(dataTable.handle_num),0) AS 'handleNum', IFNULL(SUM(dataTable.approve_num),0) AS approveNum,IFNULL(SUM(dataTable.order_complete_num),0) AS 'orderCompleteNum', IFNULL(SUM(dataTable.repeat_complete_num),0) AS 'repeatCompleteNum', IFNULL(SUM(dataTable.false_num),0) AS falseNum,IFNULL(SUM(dataTable.real_num),0) AS 'realNum', IFNULL(SUM(dataTable.false_num),0) + IFNULL(SUM(dataTable.real_num),0) AS 'allNum' FROM vm_statistics_event_num_day dataTable
AND DATE_FORMAT(dataTable.create_date,'%Y-%m-%d') = DATE_FORMAT(NOW() ,'%Y-%m-%d')
AND dataTable.create_date >= #{queryStartTime} AND dataTable.create_date <= #{queryEndTime}
AND LEFT(dataTable.county_id,2) = LEFT(#{provinceId},2)
AND LEFT(dataTable.county_id,4) = LEFT(#{cityId},4)
AND (dataTable.county_id = #{countyId} or dataTable.province_id = #{countyId} or dataTable.city_id = #{countyId})
${dataScope}

select dataTable.warning_source 'warningSource', sum(IFNULL(dataTable.order_num,0)) num from vm_statistics_event_source dataTable
AND DATE_FORMAT(dataTable.create_date ,'%Y') = DATE_FORMAT(NOW() ,'%Y')
AND DATE_FORMAT(dataTable.create_date ,'%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(NOW() ,'%Y-%m')
AND DATE_FORMAT(dataTable.create_date,'%Y-%m-%d') = DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(NOW(),interval 1 DAY) ,'%Y-%m-%d')
AND DATE_FORMAT(dataTable.create_date,'%Y-%m-%d') = DATE_FORMAT(NOW() ,'%Y-%m-%d')
AND dataTable.create_date >= #{queryStartTime} AND dataTable.create_date <= #{queryEndTime}
AND (dataTable.county_id = #{countyId} or dataTable.province_id = #{countyId} or dataTable.city_id = #{countyId})
${dataScope}
group by dataTable.warning_source
SELECT AREA_NAME FROM sys_area WHERE AREA_CODE = #{areaId}
SELECT AREA_CODE FROM sys_area WHERE AREA_PARENT_CODE = #{parentCode}
